test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct option is "**develop**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look into **meaning **of the given options - 

 
 
• crave - to want and need to have something very much. 
 
• infer - to form an opinion or decide that something is true from the information you have.
 
• develop - To cultivate or build a relationship or connection with someone over time.
 
 
• *For example: "He hoped to **develop **a strong working relationship with his new boss."*
 
 
 
• defer - to leave something until a later time.
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that allegiance to one's favourite team is built or cultivated over a period of time.
 
• The term "**allegiance**" refers to loyalty, faithfulness, or devotion to a person, group, cause, or nation. 
 
• So, **'**develop' is the most appropriate word for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer. 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *Allegiance to one’s favourite team is something that sports fans **(1)** __**develop**__* *over a period of time. They are so attached to their favourite teams that they could display (2) ______ emotions, not just during the course of the match, but much after the actual event is over. This phenomenon, (3) ______ common across the globe, is more seen in countries like Brazil, India, the US and even the UK, where the favourite sport may not be the same in each of these nations. In spite of this craze and hysteria, sport has (4) ______ a long way. It is accepted as one of the world’s most (5) ______ pastimes ever.*
